---
title: "حیدرؑ کا مسلماں نے جو خون بہایا ہے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
poet: "Navaid"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Haider Ka Musalmaan Ne Jo Khon Bahaya Hai
Sar Par Se Yeh Zainab Ke Haye Saya Uthaya Hai

1
Zarbat Ki Khabar Aayi Jis Dam Dar-e-Haider Par
Zainab Ne Rida Thami Bazu Ko Chupaya Hai

2
Karna Hai Hawalay Jo Shabbir Ko Ghazi Ke
Abbas Ko Haider Ne Nazdeek Bulaya Hai

3
Shabbir Tere Lashay Ko Kaun Uthaye Ga
Tu Ne Tu Yeh Baba Ka Taboot Uthaya Hai

4
Zainab Se Koi Pochay Aye Kofay Ki Shehzadi
Kyun Baap Se Martay Dam Tak Khud Ko Chupaya Hai

5
Shabbir Ko Zainab Ne Bhi Sar Ki Rida Samjha
Maa Keh Ke Hi Sarwar Ne Zainab Ko Bulaya Hai

6
Maa Ko Bhi Navaid Ummat Ne Roka Tha Roney Se
Zainab Ke Bhi Roney Par Ab Pehra Lagaya Hai

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/data/lyrics/haider-ka-musalman-ne-jo-khoon-bahaya-hai.md')
s=p.read_text(); _, y, b=s.split('---',2)
r=y.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n',1)[1]
for t, nums in [(r,'123456'),(b,'۱۲۳۴۵۶')]:
    groups=[g.splitlines() for g in '\\n'.join(l.strip() for l in t.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(g) for g in groups]==[2]+[3]*6
    assert ''.join(g[0] for g in groups[1:])==nums
print('Verified 14 verse lines and six numbered stanzas in each script.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script, preserving the two-line opening and six numbered stanzas. Kept the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` with sentence casing, set the direction to `rtl`, and cleared the `noUrdu` tag. Both editions have matching stanza and verse counts.

I rendered “Lashay” as «لاشے» and the in-verse “Navaid” as «نوید».
